title: Audit the test suite for assertions coupled to wall-clock bounds under full-suite load
outcome: Full-suite runs stop failing on host or cross-assembly contention one test at a time. Evidence 2026-09-04: Batch42TestsPart2 and Part3 review-snapshot convergence, Batch43 wrapper ShowFile at the 4000 ms default, Batch44 large-blob ShowFile, SharedDaemonTests IdleLinger retire handshake EOF at the 5 s HandshakeTimeout, ConcurrentWaiter 30 s harness CTS, Batch42 UnmappedReplacementHunk base_blob_unavailable at ReviewMaxBaseBlobMilliseconds — five separate red runs, each fixed narrowly and classified as test/host contention. Reviewer-filed by Phoenix::Fable.
acceptance: Every product test whose assertion presupposes a process, handshake, snapshot, or blob operation finishing within a product or test-side wall-clock bound is listed with its bound and either (a) rewritten to establish its precondition explicitly and wait on the evidence it asserts, or (b) moved to the shared test process ceiling for test-side operations, or (c) documented as intentional product-default coverage; no product bound changes; no retries that mask deterministic failures
